actions.description: The ego vehicle travels forward along the dense megacity street at a moderate speed; two small bags are visible ahead resting still on the worn road in the calm humid air.

The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03, treating the small resting bags as obstacles.

The vehicle is fully stopped from the very start of this segment and remains completely stationary for the final 2 seconds; the small bags stay still on the road just a few meters ahead amid the signage glow; the vehicle is parked and perfectly stationary and the camera does not move at all.

temporal_caption: At 0:00, the ego vehicle travels forward along the dense megacity street at a moderate speed; two small bags are visible ahead resting still on the worn road in the calm humid air. From 0:01 the vehicle brakes smoothly and continuously, its speed falling steadily, treating the small resting bags as obstacles. By 0:03 the vehicle has reached a complete standstill. From 0:03 to 0:05 the vehicle is parked and perfectly motionless: the camera does not translate at all and the framing is identical, like a still photograph.
audio_description: Ambient busy megacity audio begins with dense city hum, distant horns and tire drone. Around 0:01 the engine note drops sharply and a brief hard-braking sound is audible as the vehicle decelerates abruptly. The humid air is calm without gusts. By 0:02 the tire noise falls to near silence and, from 0:02 to 0:05, a low idle rumble under the constant city murmur dominates while the bags rest silently on the road.
